logp.method_description: The partition coefficients of the complexes in octanol and water were determined using previously reported methods [S5]. Octanol–saturated water and water–saturated octanol were prepared by stirring the mixture for 24 h. Aliquots of stock solutions of the complexes 1-6 in octanol–saturated water (2 mL) were added to the same volumes of water–saturated octanol (2 mL) and shaken in a Tarsons rotospin test tube mixer at a speed of 50 rpm min-1 for 24 h. The absorbance values of the equilibrated layers and the blanks are read at the absorption maxima ~280 nm, and the partition coefficient is calculated with the equation:log P = log[([A]org - [A]blank) / ([A]aq - [A]blank)] ... (2)where, [A]org, [A]aq and [A]blank are the absorbance of the organic layer, aqueous layer and the blank, respectively.
